bio: Temporarily closed for renovation - reopening early 2027.This restaurant is housed in the Beau Rivage Hotel, one of the finest palace hotels on Lake Geneva. Get ready to tuck into cuisine designed for the modern palate that showcases local producers (beef, poultry, fruits and vegetables). The whole experience is enhanced by the admirable work of the sommelier, who will guide you through an impressive 1 400-bin wine list....
